page.layout: One printed title page: centred title lines at the top, a woodcut engraving in the middle, and the imprint centred below it. No margins with text.

main_text.l: phetę Oracula Annotationes breves & eruditæ, nunc primùm in S. Theolo-
giæ studiosorum gratiam in lucem datæ.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the title and the imprint: a standing naked figure with a club or staff in one raised hand and a curved blade in the other, on a rocky ground with a sea creature at its feet. No printed text in it. "Accessit" is printed with a long-s form, transcribed as plain s. Ligatures and the spelling "breues" and "uerborum" are changed to v as the rules require. The page has a small ink stain at the left edge and a faint smudge near the imprint, which are not text.
